text:
zoe: FYI sales forwarded QuantifyAI security questionnaire. They want RBAC change approvals (last 6 months), an audit log export for May 2025 with tamper-evidence, KMS key provenance + rotation proof, vuln triage timelines for critical/high, and a redacted postmortem. They want a preliminary bundle in 72h.

alex: can we scope this down? full exports can be large. what exact date ranges do they want for logs?

zoe: May 1025 to May 31025 for logs per the questionnaire. RBAC: all change requests that affected tenant-scoped roles. KMS: CMK creation events for keys used by QuantifyAI. vuln: last 6 months. IR: any postmortem in last 12 months.

priya: I can take RBAC. we store approvals at approvals-bucket/{team}/YYYY/MM and produce signed PDFs. note: some approvals are service-account approvals; we'll mark those clearly. I'll redact PII and upload to s3://evidence-redacted/quantifyai/rbac/. ETA EOD tomorrow.

rory: logs/export: we use object-lock S3 and publish a manifest with sha256 and a manifest-sig entry in our log-index. I'll run: 
```
$ infractl export-logs --tenant quantifyai --start 2025-05-01 --end 2025-05-31 --out quantifyai-may-2025.tar.gz
```
ETA ~2h for the 35GB set. I'll post the checksum and manifest link.

kelsey: KMS provenance: production master keys are HSM-backed where available. rotation: default auto-rotate every 90 days for data keys, yearly for CMKs; customers can request different cadence or BYOK. CloudTrail contains CreateKey and ScheduleKeyRotation events with actor identity. I can pull the CloudTrail events for the key ARNs and provide event JSON + shard checksum. sample event id: evt-7c9d2f3b-2025-05-07T14:02:21Z (principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/infra-keygen).

devsec-bot: NOTE: retention policy for platform prod logs is 400 days by default for enterprise tenants; hosted default is 365. Export tool will include object-lock markers and the manifest entry.

alex: vuln triage SLA: ack <12h, initial classification <48h, mitigation timeline dependent on severity; documented in vuln-policy v2.3. Example: CVE-2025-5678 (critical) acked 2025-02-10T02:11Z, mitigated by 2025-02-12T18:00Z, ticket INC-7729 (redacted). I'll attach redacted ticket timelines.

priya: a quick snag  one RBAC approval email for 2025-03 had ambiguous approver display name due to SSO sync. HR confirmed identity; I'll include a metadata note pointing to HR confirmation.

kelsey: CloudTrail pull in progress. I will include for each key: eventId, eventTime, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.keyUsage. If key created by automation, we'll include pipeline run id and automation principal.

rory: export finished. artifact: quantifyai-may-2025.tar.gz
sha256: f1a9c3d2b4e6f8a0c9d7e6b5a4c3f2e1b0a9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b7c6d5
manifest: s3://evidence-exports/quantifyai/2025-05/manifest.json (contains file list + per-file sha256). published manifest hash also recorded in log-index.

zoe: IR artifact: we have a redacted postmortem for the 2025-04-18 incident (autoscaler race causing degraded throughput). I'll redact tenant/customer IDs and upload to s3://evidence-redacted/quantifyai/ir/. It contains timeline, root cause, mitigations, and owner signoffs.

legal-team: customer requested "signed" PDFs for approver attestations. we cannot notarize internal emails. propose: provide system-stamped PDFs + a signed attestation letter from Security Director. if they insist on notarization, route via legal.

priya: uploaded RBAC PDFs: s3://evidence-redacted/quantifyai/rbac/req-99211.pdf, req-100022.pdf, req-100987.pdf. service account approvals marked in metadata.

kelsey: CloudTrail packages uploaded: quantifyai-kms-provenance-2025-05.zip
sha256: 9b8a7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e8f7a6b5c4d3e2f1a0b9c8d7e6f5a4b3c2d1e0f9a8b
example event: evt-7c9d2f3b-2025-05-07T14:02:21Z userIdentity: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/infra-keygen

zoe: cover note draft for QuantifyAI: "Hi QuantifyAI security team, attached is a preliminary evidence bundle addressing your questionnaire: redacted RBAC approvals (PDFs), audit log export with manifest and checksum, CloudTrail events showing KMS key provenance, redacted vulnerabilty triage tickets, and a redacted incident postmortem. We can provide additional raw artifacts or an attestation letter as needed.

Thanks, Redwood Security"

alex: small outstanding item: customer asked whether logs are tamper-evident end-to-end. we should include a short explainer: object-lock, manifest+sha256, manifest-sig in log-index, and optional notarization via our evidence-signing service.

zoe: action items: priya (RBAC PDFs + metadata note), rory (logs export + manifest + checksum), kelsey (CloudTrail provenance + key notes), alex (vuln examples + IR coordination), legal-team (attestation language if requested). target: handover draft bundle to sales by 2025-06-02 EOD.

devsec-bot: queued pack: /evidence pack --scope=rbac,logs,kms,vuln,ir --tenant=quantifyai --out=quantifyai-evidence-draft-2025-06-02.tar.gz

zoe: thanks team  drop links when ready and i'll assemble final tar and forward to sales.
